message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/sleuthkit && sed -n '100,200p' tsk/fs/tsk_apfs.hpp` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: The vulnerability is in APFS parsing. The `memory_view::as<T>()` does an unchecked `reinterpret_cast` which can cause an out-of-bounds read. Let me look at the APFS code around the usage.
